<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Wild Speech](/Feats.aspx?ID=5520) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 80

**Archetype** [Wild Mimic](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=226)

**Prerequisites**
[Wild Mimic Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5515); [Animal Empathy (Ranger)](/Feats.aspx?ID=4865) or the ability to speak with a type of animal

</column>

---

Your connection to the denizens of the wilds grows ever stronger, and you find yourself able to speak with animals like you would in your native tongue. You can speak with all [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) and [beasts](/Traits.aspx?ID=547). If you have [Animal Empathy](/Feats.aspx?ID=4865), you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) on animals.
